title: Competition seasons
subtitle: Control registration windows and which season is live
empty: No seasons have been created yet.
load_error_message: We could not fetch the season list from the server. Check your connection and try again.
close_confirm_body: Close the registration window for the {{year}} season? New contestants will no longer be able to register, and the action will be recorded in the audit logs.
restore_body: The "{{slug}}" season returns to draft, and its archival record (date, reason and who performed it) is cleared. Stages, rules and eligible countries are left untouched. Restoring is only available for seasons that never actually started — the server will refuse anything else and explain why.
form_frozen_notice: This season is frozen because registration was opened on it. The server will not accept any change to its details.
rules_catalogs_failed: Could not load the option catalogs (participation types, tajweed levels, countries). Rules cannot be set before they load — close and reopen this dialog to try again.
rules_frozen_notice: This season is frozen because registration was opened on it. The rules contestants registered under cannot be changed, and the server will refuse any save.
country_search_placeholder: Search by country name or code
no_countries: No countries have been added to the system yet.
slug_confirmation_label: To confirm, type the season's identifier (slug) exactly as shown below:
archive_body: Archiving is the final state in a season's lifecycle and cannot be undone. The season will no longer be editable or able to go live.
archive_reason_placeholder: For example: the competition ended and the final results were approved
cancel_body: Cancelling is permanent and cannot be undone. The season moves to archived, and there is no way to bring it back to draft. The reason is stored on the season's record along with who performed the action.
cancel_reason_placeholder: For example: the required number of participants was not reached
cancel_reason_required: A reason for cancelling is required
reopen_info: The season returns to "registration open" and becomes the active season. Its rules and stages stay frozen exactly as they are — only the registration window changes. Registration can be closed again at any time.
reopen_reason_placeholder: For example: extending registration by a week at the committee's request
reopen_reason_required: A reason for reopening is required
reopen_single_active_note: The system allows only one active season at a time. If another season is currently active, the server will refuse and name the season whose registration must be closed first.
create_error: Could not create the season. Check the details.
update_error: Could not update the season. Check the details.
rules_error: Could not save the season's rules. Check the details.
open_success: Registration is now open for the season
open_error: Could not open the registration window.
close_success: Registration is now closed for the season
close_error: Could not close the registration window.
restore_success: The season was restored to draft
reopen_success: Registration was reopened for the season
err_restore_frozen: This season cannot be restored because registration was opened on it and its rules were frozen. Restoring is only available for seasons that were cancelled while still a draft and never actually started.
err_restore_snapshots: This season cannot be restored because it holds a saved snapshot of its rules, which means registration really did open. Archiving here is a permanent record and cannot be undone.
err_restore_dependents: This season cannot be restored because data is linked to it (applications, results, judge assignments or streams).
err_restore_active: This season cannot be restored because it is still registered as the active season.
err_restore_not_archived: This season is not archived, so there is nothing to restore.
err_reopen_not_closed: Registration can only be reopened for a season whose status is "registration closed".
err_reopen_another_active: Registration cannot be reopened because another season is the active one, and the system allows only a single active season.{{named}} Close its registration first, then try again.
v_year_min: The season year must be 2020 or later
v_year_max: That is not a valid year
v_slug_min: The identifier must be at least 3 characters
v_slug_pattern: The identifier may contain only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens
v_reg_start_required: Please pick a registration start date
v_reg_end_required: Please pick a registration end date
v_start_date_required: Please pick a season start date
v_end_date_required: Please pick a season end date
v_public_name_ar_required: Please enter the Arabic public name
v_public_name_en_required: Please enter the English public name
v_public_name_es_required: Please enter the Spanish public name
v_reg_end_after_start: Registration must end after it starts
v_start_after_reg_end: The season must start on or after the registration end date
v_end_after_start: The season must end after it starts
v_age_int: Age must be a whole number
v_min_age_min: The minimum age must be at least 1
v_min_age_max: That minimum age is not realistic
v_max_age_min: The maximum age must be at least 1
v_max_age_max: That maximum age is not realistic
v_countries_min: At least one eligible country must be selected
v_max_age_gte_min: The maximum age must be greater than or equal to the minimum
